name: DataStore
abi_source: Curated minimal subset (getUint/getInt/getAddress/getBool/RoleStore). Wave does NOT bind DataStore directly — every read flows through Reader, which takes the DataStore address as the first argument. Pinned here for completeness so a future Wave that needs raw key/value reads has the binding point. Full ABI available via Sourcify at sourcify.dev/server/files/any/42161/0xFD70de6b91282D8017aA4E741e9Ae325CAb992d8 if needed.
notes: Canonical key/value store. Reader.* methods take this address as their first param.
